data.body: [P2] Add composed coverage for grouped dispatch. The new tests check wrapping, unwrapping and module loading separately, but never exercise this handler with the runner’s envelope and a real durable handler. Local example tests bypass this path, leaving routing, context forwarding and replay input restoration dependent on cloud tests. CONTRIBUTING requires composed tests for changes spanning components. Add a composed regression covering example selection, original payload and context forwarding, followed by suspension and replay through the dispatcher.
